name: configurations
description: List of Java Components configuration properties

name: enable_telemetry
description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo.

name: scale
description:
Java component scaling configurations

- `max_replicas` - Optional. Maximum number of Java component replicas
- `min_replicas` - Optional. Minimum number of Java component replicas. Defaults to 1 if not set

name: spring_cloud_gateway_routes
type:
list(object({
    filters    = optional(list(string))
    id         = string
    order      = optional(number)
    predicates = optional(list(string))
    uri        = string
  }))
description:
Gateway route definition.

- `filters` - List of gateway filters to apply.
- `id` - ID for the route.
- `order` - Ordering of the route.
- `predicates` - List of predicates to match.
- `uri` - URI of the route.

name: parent_id
description: The parent resource ID for this resource.

name: service_binds
description: List of Java Components that are bound to the Java component
